title: File:Student protest crowd listens to woman speaking.jpg
description:
A woman shares her thoughts about the shortcomings of being a student at Wilkes University as she has recorded them on her phone.
On November 11th, 2025, Wilkes University student government organized a protest outside of Weckesser Hall on Wilkes University campus due to a lack of transparency from University Administration (mainly then Wilkes University President Dr. Cant) who had just been responsible for the sudden announcement of that Wilkes University was in a four million dollar deficit.
